nodes.label: Core Platform
nodes.description: The gravitational centre of the product. Every workflow, integration, and data stream orbits this hub.

nodes.label: Job Management
nodes.description: Create, assign, and track field jobs from request to completion across the whole lifecycle.

nodes.label: Scheduling
nodes.description: Drag-and-drop scheduling board that balances technician availability against job priority.

nodes.label: Dispatch
nodes.description: Routes the right technician to the right job and pushes live updates to the field.

nodes.label: Quotes
nodes.description: Build, send, and track quotes that convert directly into scheduled jobs once approved.

nodes.label: Invoicing
nodes.description: Turns completed work into invoices and reconciles them with the accounting system.

nodes.label: Timesheets
nodes.description: Captures labour hours per job and feeds them into payroll and cost tracking.

nodes.label: Asset Registry
nodes.description: A living register of every serviced asset, its history, and its maintenance schedule.

nodes.label: Inventory
nodes.description: Tracks parts and stock across warehouses and vans, and reserves them against jobs.

nodes.label: Field App
nodes.description: The offline-first mobile app technicians use on site to run jobs, capture photos, and collect signatures.

nodes.label: Identity & Access
nodes.description: Authentication, roles, and tenant isolation enforced at the edge of every request.

nodes.label: Notifications
nodes.description: Real-time push, email, and SMS notifications delivered over a streaming channel.

nodes.label: Search
nodes.description: Unified search across jobs, customers, and assets with typo tolerance and ranking.

nodes.label: File Storage
nodes.description: Secure object storage for photos, documents, and generated PDFs, scoped per tenant.

nodes.label: Data Warehouse
nodes.description: The analytical store that consolidates operational data for reporting and modelling.

nodes.label: Reporting
nodes.description: Dashboards and scheduled reports built on top of the warehouse for operational insight.

nodes.label: Audit Log
nodes.description: An append-only record of every meaningful action, used for compliance and debugging.

nodes.label: Vector Index
nodes.description: Tenant-isolated embeddings that power retrieval for the AI features.

nodes.label: AI Copilot
nodes.description: A conversational assistant that reads and writes across the platform on the user's behalf.

nodes.label: Retrieval (RAG)
nodes.description: Grounds the copilot in tenant data by retrieving the most relevant context per query.

nodes.label: Bill Extraction
nodes.description: Pulls structured line items out of supplier bills and PDFs using a guarded dual-model pipeline.

nodes.label: Photo Validation
nodes.description: Checks on-site photos for completeness and flags duplicates and anomalies before sign-off.

nodes.label: Demand Forecast
nodes.description: Predicts job volume and parts demand to inform scheduling and stock decisions.

nodes.label: Intent Classifier
nodes.description: A lightweight router that reads each request and sends it to the right downstream agent.

nodes.label: Accounting Sync
nodes.description: Two-way sync of invoices, payments, and contacts with external accounting software.

nodes.label: Payments
nodes.description: Collects card and bank payments against invoices and reconciles them automatically.

nodes.label: Maps & Routing
nodes.description: Geocoding, travel-time estimates, and route optimisation for dispatch.

nodes.label: Calendar Sync
nodes.description: Keeps technician calendars in sync with external providers in both directions.

nodes.label: SMS & Email
nodes.description: Outbound messaging gateway used by notifications and customer communications.
